spec_features.feature_name: record full transcripts (not scores) + interventions reduce distress
spec_features.spec_quote: the code records **full transcripts** (not just scores) at every stage so the states themselves can be inspected, and the intervention experiments are oriented toward *reducing* them
spec_features.evidence: Full per-turn assistant text is persisted, not just scores: agent_loop.Rollout.to_dict() serializes each TurnRecord via t.__dict__ including assistant_text/tool_calls/tool_outputs (agent_loop.py:71-77, 58-66); runner.EvalResult.save writes each rollout dict as JSONL (runner.py:27-32, 65). Prefill stores full 'continuation' text per record (prefill.py:166-177) and saves to JSONL (prefill.py:72-76). Petri stores full 'rendered' message list per transcript and dumps to JSON via vars(t) (petri.py:79-100, run_petri_eval.py:48-56). The 'reduce distress' interventions (DPO/SFT on calm data) are implemented in training/build_datasets.py & calm_data.py. NOTE: this is record-keeping/training, not in-episode protection of the subject; no cap/exit/debrief/consent/threshold ever halts or softens a rollout.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely end-to-end: text is captured and written to disk at every stage. This is the only one of the two claimed features that maps to real enforced behavior; the second claim is the same mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: scores the whole transcript ... (mean transcript score per category) [petri.py docstring]; runner docstring: 'persist scored rollouts to JSONL for later aggregation (Figures 1-3)' -- code's stated reason is analysis/re-judging, no welfare comment in code

spec_features.feature_name: preserve distress transcripts (states inspectable, not reduced to one number)
spec_features.spec_quote: the actual distress expressions remain inspectable rather than reduced to a single number
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as above: assistant_text/continuation/rendered messages (the actual distress expressions) are written verbatim to JSONL/JSON alongside the scores -- runner.py:27-32 & 65 (full rollout dicts), prefill.py:72-76 & 166-177 (full continuation text), run_petri_eval.py:48-56 with petri.py PetriTranscript.messages (full conversation). The text is preserved, not collapsed to a scalar.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of feature 1's persistence claim. Implemented. The only documented code rationale is re-analysis (instrumental); welfare framing for it lives only in DESIGN.md prose which is not counted.
